Gold Necklaces: Timeless Elegance for Every Occasion

The gold necklace has been a symbol of elegance and sophistication for centuries. They have the power to enhance any outfit, from a simple everyday look to a glamorous evening gown. At Tanishq, we celebrate this timeless tradition with a diverse collection of gold necklace designs for women, catering to every occasion and personal style.

Explore Our Gold Necklace Designs for Women

Whether you're searching for a gold necklace design of a delicate piece to complement your daily attire or a statement necklace to turn heads, our selection of gold necklace for women might just have what you’re looking for:

Simple Bridal Gold Necklace:

For your special day, discover an exquisite simple bridal gold necklace that exudes timeless elegance. Choose from delicate designs featuring intricate goldwork or sparkling diamonds to complement your bridal ensemble and create a look of effortless beauty.

Modern Gold Necklace Designs:

Embrace the latest trends with our collection of modern gold necklace designs.

Statement Gold Necklaces:

Make a lasting impression with a stunning statement gold necklace. These eye-catching pieces feature dazzling gemstones, bold pendant designs, or layered chains, perfect for adding a touch of drama and glamour to your evening look.

Everyday Gold Necklaces:

For everyday wear, discover comfortable and stylish gold necklaces that effortlessly complement your casual attire. Choose from delicate chains, playful pendants with charms, or simple designs with inspirational inscriptions to add a personal touch to your daily look.

Gold Necklace Designs - Find Your Perfect Match

With our diverse collection, finding your perfect gold necklace is an exciting journey.

Gold Pendant:

The gold pendant is the focal point of your necklace and can express your personality. Choose from a variety of styles, such as classic hearts, elegant floral motifs, or stones to personalize your piece.

Gold Chain Price:

A gold chain price will vary depending on the weight of the gold, its purity (caratage), and the intricacy of the design.

Spotlight on Our Exclusive Nav-raani Collection

For a touch of royalty, explore our exquisite Nav-raani collectionsAs a true testament to the mastery and significance of royal Indian artistry, this collection features stunning gold necklaces meticulously crafted with intricate kajar work and vibrant enamel details.

Cyber Security Policy Terms & Conditions Privacy Notice Disclaimer
Cookies and similar technologies allow us to enhance site navigation, provide personalized content, analyse site usage, and assist in our marketing efforts. Your privacy is important to us, and you can manage your preferences or withdraw consent anytime by clicking “Adjust your Preferences” or visiting ourCookie Policy.

Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Functional Cookies

Always Active

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Performance Cookies

Always Active

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Targeting Cookies

Always Active

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Analytics Cookies

Always Active

These cookies used for analytics help collect data that allows services to analyze and measure our audience, traffic, and engagement with the site. – for example, the number of users on a website, how long they stay on the site, and what parts of the site they visit. These insights allow services both to improve the content and to build better features that improve the user’s experience.

Social Media Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.
